'''Chian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] enrolled in the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Jedi academy|academy]] during the final decade of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Kajain'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kajain'sa'Nikto]] from the planet [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]], Chian was identified as [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and given over to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Assigned to the Mighty [[Bear Clan]], an [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|Initiate Clan]] whose members were known for their bravery, Initiate Chian received his earliest instruction from his clan leader, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].

During one of the clan's daily [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] instructional courses on the [[Jedi Temple veranda|Temple's veranda]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] approached Grand Master Yoda with a question. It appeared the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Temple's Archives]] were incomplete and missing a [[Kamino system/Legends|system]]. One of Chian's peers, [[J. K. Burtola/Legends|J. K. Burtola]], suggested that someone had erased the files, therefore explaining the Archives' seeming incompleteness.<ref name="AOTC" />
